text: This report recommends approving two new policies; Disability Management Policy and Procedure, and The Respect Policy and Conflict Resolution Process in Appendix A.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the Disability Management Policy and Procedure, and the Respect Policy and Conflict Resolution Process as set out in Appendix A to the report (November 20, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
